description: This source file defines the class StoppedKamonTimer, which implements the StoppedTimer interface. It provides functionality for stopping a timer, recording elapsed time with Kamon metrics, handling timer segments, and managing associated tags and metadata within a monitoring context.

classes.name: StoppedKamonTimer
classes.description: Implementation of a timer that integrates with Kamon for metrics; capable of stopping timers, recording duration, and handling tags.
